title: 第7章 我们宗主可是化神期巅峰修真界第一人第8章 你就是白露
slug: 脸盲宗主她又抓错人了
content_zh:
还是修仙界好啊！
连最普通的灵葡萄都如此美味绝伦！
只是光这么干吃，好像有点寡淡无聊。
要是有部电视剧追追就好了……
这样想着，白露懒洋洋地伸出手指，对着半空虚虚一点。
顿时，一面巨大无比，光洁如水的灵力光镜便凭空出现在殿内半空中。
光镜中映照出的。
正是合欢宗各峰弟子们正在刻苦修炼、或切磋比试的场景。
看着镜中那五光十色的法术和仙气飘飘的琼楼玉宇。
以及天空中穿梭飞舞的各色流光溢彩的法宝飞剑。
白露这才满意地点了点头。
这叫什么？
这就叫我在修仙界沉浸式观看仙侠连续剧！
于是乎，白露便惬意地用手臂支着头，慵懒地斜倚在软榻之上。
而一旁果盘中的葡萄则仿佛有了生命般
自动剥开晶莹剔透的果皮，精准地送入她微张的樱唇之中。
这日子，简直美得冒泡，赛过活神仙。
而在合欢宗各座灵峰上潜心修炼的弟子以及各位长老们
还浑然不知自己的头顶上空，正有一个他们完全无法察觉的神识巨网，在悄无声息地看着他们的一举一动。
不过看了一会儿，白露就觉得有些索然无味起来。

画面中展现的，无非是些炼丹控火、绘制符箓、打坐练气等极为常规枯燥的修炼日常。
白露有些意兴阑珊地撤掉了那面巨大水镜。
然而，在撤掉水镜后，她不由得陷入了沉思。
似乎这合欢宗的整体氛围，并非她原先想象中那般……嗯，那般不务正业。
恰恰相反
它更像一个包罗万象的综合性修炼圣地
甚至比许多外界所谓的名门正派，其门下弟子显得更加刻苦自律，所学也更为庞杂精深。
除了刚才看到的炼丹、符箓、阵法、剑道外
光镜中惊鸿一瞥的还有炼器、医修、音修、御兽、傀儡术……等等等等。
简直是五花八门，什么都有。
虽然说修真者通常无需睡眠。
但谁让白露的灵魂是从现代世界穿越而来的呢？
content_en:
It’s better to go to the world of immortality!
Even the most common spiritual grapes are so delicious!
Just eating like this seems a bit bland and boring.
It would be great if there was a TV series to follow...
Thinking like this, Bai Lu stretched out her fingers lazily and pointed at the void.
Suddenly, a huge spiritual light mirror as bright and clean as water appeared out of thin air in the hall.
reflected in a light mirror.
This is the scene where the disciples from various peaks of the Hehuan Sect are practicing hard or competing in competitions.
Looking at the colorful spells and the fairy-like Qionglou Yuyu in the mirror.
As well as various colorful magical flying swords flying in the sky.
Bai Lu nodded with satisfaction.
What is this called?
This means I can immerse myself in the world of cultivating immortals and watch fairy tale series!
As a result, Bai Lu comfortably supported her head on her arms and leaned lazily on the soft couch.
The grapes in the fruit plate on the side seemed to be alive.
It automatically peeled off the crystal clear peel and accurately inserted it into her slightly open lips.
This day was so beautiful that it was even better than a living god.
And the disciples and elders who devote themselves to cultivation on the various spiritual peaks of Hehuan Sect
They were still completely unaware that there was a giant network of spiritual consciousness above their heads that they could not detect at all, quietly watching their every move.
But after watching it for a while, Bai Lu felt a little boring.
What is shown in the picture is nothing more than the extremely routine and boring daily practice of refining elixirs to control fire, drawing talismans, meditating and practicing Qi.
Bai Lu removed the huge water mirror with some disappointment.
However, after removing the water mirror, she couldn't help but fall into deep thought.
It seemed that the overall atmosphere of the Hehuan Sect was not as...well, as dishonest as she originally imagined.
On the contrary
It is more like an all-encompassing comprehensive holy land for cultivation.
Even compared to many so-called famous and upright sects in the outside world, his disciples appear to be more diligent and self-disciplined, and their knowledge is more complex and profound.
In addition to the alchemy, talismans, formations, and swordsmanship that I just saw,
Also glimpsed in the light mirror are weapon refining, medical cultivation, music cultivation, beast control, puppetry... and so on.
It’s so diverse and has everything.
Although it is said that cultivators usually do not need sleep.
But who told Bai Lu’s soul to come from the modern world?
